notes.title: Announcing the Pool Panic “Cue More Chaos” update & Couch Co-Op Fest Discount
notes.notes:
To celebrate Pool Panic being back in our hands and self published. We bring you a fresh new free update coming Feb 10th to Switch and Steam and a mind-blowing 80% off sale as part of the Steam Couch Co-Op festival.

So what's in the “Cue More Chaos” update?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32391129/ef23724aa519d221030f8e0f1c8c4b336bb745bb.gif
Cue the Chaos! Players want more chaos! Yes! We cracked open the hood and tipped in 3 more cue balls to Pool Panic’s story mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32391129/01eb9842fa9355744fdf08417698ff513bbe1c55.gif

You can now access local co-op mode from the pause menu on the world map. Adding from 2 ( sublime ) to 4 ( absolute chaos ) players to the mix. Smash a JCB with friends. Halt a wedding with friends. Ski with friends (as a weird combined omniball). And of course, if you have opened up Panic Mode. Panic with friends to your heart's content. 

With all the co-op love, don't worry. Vs mode hasn’t been forgotten. Get your vengeance in 2 shiny new VS rounds joining the original line up. Motor cycling mayhem and last ball standing melting candles.

Don’t forget you can even invite friends to connect to you via Steam Remote Play to turn local co-op into online!

Players want less chaos! Yes there is too much chaos. Sometimes you just feel like you need a big old vacuum cleaner to suck anything rolling into the holes. Vacuums are too noisy though, so we added magnets! Turn on Magnetic Hole Assist per player in the control settings to make shots easier, by pulling rolling balls towards the holes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32391129/7adde578d94e0d09aa57134971d9dcb6524cd23d.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32391129/cd442bd1068e2a7ceef9beb3942451638f16edad.gif

The ideal help for younger players, decreasing the need for shot accuracy. Or just a way to smash through the levels for some more casual arcadey fun.

[previewyoutube=MA2duChFVfE;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: A quick Patch 3.5
notes.notes:
Hey! We're so glad to be back!
We’ve just dusted off some cobwebs and released a quick interim patch. Let's call it Patch 3.5. 
Another update is coming soon and we think it will be fun 👁️👁️.

Splash screen updates.
The main purpose is to swap out Publisher logos, now Rekim is self publishing the game. Hurray!

We have changed the old publisher logo for a tribute to our good friend Gareth Jones ( Grandmaster Gareth) 1980 – 2022. Gareth provided a vast wealth of tracks for Pool Panic’s soundtrack. There are an unbelievable 96 tracks on Spotify.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32391129/7f9b847b24f8b584fb995b4909dfa2532d799b88.png

An incredible guy and a joy to sit and chat with. He had an infectious enthusiasm for the deepest corners of strange musical pickings. A music making machine, working on community projects, theatre, tv, video games, bands, his own minute melodies and of course his band Misty’s Big Adventure. Whenever his band Misty’s Big Adventure were touring nearby, it always felt like they were bringing a bit of home from Birmingham to wherever I was at the time.

When I jokingly suggested to Gareth that there were over 100 levels in Pool Panic and I wanted a different track for each one, I can’t think of many other people who, given the time scale, would seem genuinely excited at the prospect. When I told him I was joking and not to worry, he seemed a bit disappointed and said “Well. I’m aiming for that anyway”. The days a new batch of his tracks came in for us to try out and see how they transformed things, were a real highlight of the development.
He is sorely missed by us. Thanks Gareth!

Clunky gear change back to patch notes...

Menu improvements
We’ve given the menu screens a spring clean and made them clearer on smaller screens like the SteamDeck and Switch. This paved the way for a future update.



 All platforms now have “left handed mode” to flip aim and walk on a gamepad.
 Keyboard and mouse options are hidden when opening a menu with a gamepad.
 Local multiplayer games now allow for individual controller settings to be fully changed per controller from the pause menu.

Updates

 Added animated diagram to the lock on and walk tutorial.
 Tutorial no longer waits until you have used a soft shot.
 Added wearable inflatable wrestler ball arms to car crash level for fun.
 Added wearable bumper tables to the diner levels to up the chaos.
 Added wearable bumpers to the street party level and popped a rat under some tables.
 Final Boss no longer restarts when you get caught by the ghost. It was too hard.
 Automatically reduce speed of shots for nearby pockets out in the open without surrounding cushions.



Fixes

 Joust balls count towards VS pots.
 Mouse control fix for jump when using inverted aim.
 Fixed issue where the wax floor levels sometimes don’t trigger the end level melt, if the 8ball is potted at the same time as another ball.
 Gallery tower room was jumping when looping pre activation.
 Holding a direction on the menus should correctly repeat on every menu now.


Thanks for playing! We are so pleased to be able to keep Pool Panic in the stores.

notes.title: Pool Panic Patch 3 Is Live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/f39c354ba6df039453b9e15b2046e2045512801a.jpg


After a few weeks of testing and fantastic feedback from all of you, we're excited to push Patch 3 of Pool Panic live to the main game! 

This patch includes a number of improvements to the game's camera, a few behind the scene bug fixes, and adjustments to some of the more bombastic balls in the game. 

We hope you enjoy! Below are the notes. 

 Camera Improvements  

 Newly reworked camera from the ground up.
 Increased camera focus on where you are walking. 
 Increased camera focus on what you are aiming at. 
 Improved focus on key moments like pots remain in the camera shot. 


 Community Requests 

 Aim lines are also now visible behind obstructions, allowing you to better keep track of shots, especially on more chaotic levels. 
 Reactive balls (you know, those skittish ones) now increase the time they are floored after being hit.
 VS Mode points now fly in quicker.


 Bug Fixes  
 Several minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: Patch 3 Beta Test Up! - Improved camera and a bit more
notes.notes:
Hello there you handsome devils. 

Patch 3 is nearly ready and we’ve got a beta for you to try before we push
it to live.

The patch features a newly reworked camera, with more focus on where you are walking and what you are aiming at. All this while focusing that key moments like pots remain in shot. 

Aim lines are also now visible behind obstructions, allowing you to better keep track of shots, especially on more chaotic levels. 

Please check it out, and let us know what you think! There's still time to incorporate your feedback before we move from the beta branch, to the full game. 

Cheers

- Rekim & Adult Swim Games

notes.title: Patch 2 live - improved mouse controls and more
notes.notes:
Pool Panic ‘Patch 2’ is now live in the main branch so you can get your hands on improved Mouse controls, extra menu options and other fixes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/3d9121f19dfbee4550d76d7415b1dfd42ee81a71.png

To go with it the Discord is now live so pop in for a chat!
http://discord.gg/fqYPVbW 

What's in Patch 2?

We now have Trading cards!

Most Requested - Improved mouse controls:


Previously the mouse was emulating a gamepad stick and staying in position while lock-on moved. The mouse now tracks the aim line so movement is more intuitive (You can revert back to the stick mode in the control settings menu).
Shot power has been adjusted and will now always be either a hard or soft shot, depending which button you press, regardless of mouse distance.
Returning to centre to cancel aim is easier.
Cancel aim using "C".
We now have an overlay showing where the mouse cursor is when aiming (You can disable it from the control settings menu).
Mouse sensitivity has been added in to the control settings menu.
When you are locked-on to a ball, mouse sensitivity will be reduced based on the new "Focus Sensitivity" option in the control settings. This makes it easier to fine tune your aim.


Lock-on changes:


A new “manual lock-on” option has been added to let you handle lock-on yourself. Selecting it disables auto lock-on and lets you hold Left-Trigger (gamepad) or Left-Shift (keyboard) to lock-on.
Even if you're not set to "manual lock-on" you can still tap Left-Trigger (gamepad) or Left-Shift (keyboard) to immediately lock-on without the wait.
Cancelling lock-on is now easier! Hold Left-Bumper (gamepad) or the middle mouse button to break out of a lock-on. You can also do that to just disable lock-on temporarily at any point, for as long as you hold the button.


Updates & bug fixes:


Trophy data has been reworked with a bug fix to gold trophy counts and timer trophies. When you first load the game, any trophy-related achievements that had failed to pop will do so immediately.
To make it easier to track your progress, the map Pause menu shows ‘pray points’ left to send to the tower, levels left to complete and gold trophies collected so far.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/9866c104175ac287401d737b27e56a7ca27c95e2.png
While playing a level, you can now see which trophies you have previously won; they are shown as coloured coins on the base of the trophy display.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/5c663bc9bcad3a05cfaaef5056a3f0a60f66a073.pngWindowed mode no longer causes issues if you have another window titled "PoolPanic" open.
Crazy golf and Aquarium house in the Suburbs now counts correctly towards level counts when reloading. (You may find an extra prayer point waiting for you if you've completed them before).


New and improved options menus:


Menus should all be controllable by mouse now.
The mouse cursor has been reduced in size to make it more accurate.
Settings menu now has
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/9195b64c73db347ac70920643666f756337eb9f7.png
    
        Audio Settings
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/5f4270fbdc5e7191c65928d715ae03a51712b71a.png
        
            SFX VOLUME
            MUSIC VOLUME
            MUTE MUSIC
        
        Control Settings
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/28a93dab8af122becf335e4b137558ead3ec3cbb.png
        
            Invert Aim
            Vibrate
            Manual Lock-on (Holding LT or left shift will now lock-on manually, no auto lock-on)
            Focus Sensitivity (change the amount the aim slows when locked-on)
            Show Mouse Overlay [X] (hides the new mouse overlay)
            Treat mouse as stick [X] (if you liked the mouse before this will change it back)
            Mouse Sensitivity (change the mouse speed)
        
        Graphics Settings
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32391129/dab0dce63f66b3c4c983662434697d095bf94703.png
        
            Resolution selection
            Windowed
        
    


That's patch 2!

Hey, hey, what about the camera?:

While we're finishing this off, we are now getting to work on ‘Patch 3’ which will be focused on camera improvements to help you keep balls on screen. As with this patch, there will be a beta version for you to test out before it’s released. Patch 3 is currently the last planned patch.

notes.title: Patch 2 beta test available - improved mouse controls and more
notes.notes:

There is still time to give us feedback and get your changes into this update, so please give it a go this weekend and post your thoughts on the Patch 2 discussion thread!

Thanks,
            Mike

notes.title: Pool Panic Patch 1 is up now!
notes.notes:
Patch 1 is a quick hotfix for some immediate issues while we work on Patch 2, which will include clearer keyboard & mouse controls and expanded audiovisual options. Thanks everyone for your feedback, and please continue to shoot your thoughts and ideas our way!  

Changelog:

Dialog box to select resolution & toggle Windowed mode now opened at start by default. This is an interim fix while we add these options to the in-game menus.
A few achievements weren't popping, and these have been fixed. They will be unlocked retroactively when you next start the game. Finally you will receive the recognition you deserve for satisfying the chalk man!
Reduced the time taken by the "Hold your aim" section of the tutorial.
Added a new splash screen to promote gamepad use over keyboard and mouse.
